steps.en: Install the CLI, scaffold a project, start a local instance
steps.zh: 装好 CLI、初始化项目、起一个本地实例

steps.en: Build the query with an SDK builder, not a query language
steps.zh: 用 SDK 的 builder 拼查询，而不是写查询语言

steps.en: Takes the operation tree as inline JSON on one endpoint
steps.zh: 在一个端点上收下操作树 JSON，无需编译部署

steps.en: Runs graph traversal, vector and BM25 text search in one transaction on one snapshot
steps.zh: 同一事务、同一快照里跑图遍历、向量与 BM25 全文检索

value.en: One database and one transaction for relationships, embeddings and keywords — nothing to sync between a graph store, a vector store and a search cluster
value.zh: 关系、向量和关键词就是同一个数据库、同一个事务——不用再在三套存储之间做同步

sources: docs/llms.txt (quickstart): `curl -sSL "https://install.helix-db.com" | bash`, `helix init local`, `helix start dev`, `writeBatch().varAs("alice", g().addN("User", { username: "alice" }))`, `readBatch().varAs("users", g().nWithLabel("User"))`
README.md "Writing queries with the SDKs": authors queries with the Rust/TypeScript/Go/Python DSL and sends them to `POST /v2/query` with no build or deploy step
docs/database/helix-db/introduction.mdx: one labeled property graph; vector, BM25 text and secondary indexes are access paths over node/edge properties; ACID across graph, vector and text
docs/database/helix-cloud/start-here/architecture.mdx: single writer + readers behind a gateway, object storage as the durable system of record
docs/database/helix-db/start-here/local-development/local-server.mdx: `helix init local`, `helix start dev`, queries at `http://localhost:6969/v2/query`
